audit_result.proof_trace: The code calls supabase.auth.signOut() on four post-exchange authorization failures (lines 101, 111, 116, 142), but does NOT call it on exchangeCodeForSession failure (lines 67–80) nor on earlier failure paths (lines 38–54, 56–59, 84–89). A pre-existing session survives these failure paths because Supabase leaves existing cookies untouched when the exchange fails. The omission is structurally inconsistent with the developer's own signOut() pattern applied elsewhere.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker CSRF-redirects an authenticated victim to /auth/callback?code=<replayed_or_expired_code>; exchangeCodeForSession fails, the victim is sent to /login but retains their prior session cookie — or, if the Supabase SDK internally clears session state during a failed PKCE exchange, the victim ends up in a broken authenticated state with no cleanup performed.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-post-004.text: On OAuth authentication failure, user session must be fully signed out before redirect.
